name: apache-https-example
description: An Ansible playbook example that installs Apache on Ubuntu, generates self-signed TLS materials, configures an HTTPS virtual host and sample content, enables SSL, and restarts Apache.

name: apache-ssl-hardening-example
description: An Ansible playbook that hardens Apache SSL settings by permitting TLS 1.2 and notifying service handlers for configuration changes.

name: chef-automate-infra-server-bootstrap
description: Bootstraps Chef Automate and Chef Infra Server deployment, including host preparation and creation of a Chef Server user and organization.

name: chef-infra-server-bootstrap
description: Bootstraps Chef Infra Server deployment without Automate, including host preparation and creation of a Chef Server user and organization.
